records.text: Isn't ICE trained by the IDF, and why is an American security field office located in Tel Aviv?

appearances.snippet: I mean, isn't like ice has been trained by the IDF? Isn't that the same tactics that's used by ice? ... When they did the locations, ... they found that the location of one of their field offices is in Tel Aviv. ... Why do we have ICE ... office ... in Tel ... Aviv?

verification.notes: ICE’s Homeland Security Investigations component does maintain an attaché presence in Tel Aviv for transnational criminal investigations. records.text: Candace Owens said the messages attributed to Tyler Robinson and Lance Twiggs were reportedly extracted by a company based in Tel Aviv.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: By the way, just a little fun add that the messages were apparently extracted by a company based in Tel Aviv.

verification.notes: The apparent reference is to Cellebrite. Cellebrite is an Israeli digital-forensics company, but its current official headquarters address is Petah Tikva, not Tel Aviv. Publicly accessible hearing material reviewed did not independently establish that Cellebrite performed the specific message extraction, so the company-location portion is broadly right but imprecise and the case-specific portion remains unconfirmed.
